name: Gelorwydd

attributes.attribute: bathed the dying on battlefields with his own blood

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gelorwydd is an obscure Welsh hero. Some texts describe him as a warrior who bathed the dying on battlefields with his own blood. That act is said to have brought the wounded great peace in their final moments. Little else is known about him.

okr.objective: Document Gelorwydd as an obscure Welsh hero with a distinctive battlefield mercy.
key_results: Establish Gelorwydd as a Person-typed Welsh hero
Record the act of bathing the dying with his own blood
